network.name: Nebraska Libraries
network.notes: Nebraska public libraries with Library of Things programs. Library of Things adoption is still emerging in Nebraska compared to New England states.

items.name: Board Games
items.description: Collection of board games for adults and families (limit 2 per card)

items.name: Cake Pans
items.description: Variety of cake pans, muffin tins, and cookie cutters (limit 2 per card)

items.name: Disc Golf Kit
items.description: Kit with 6-12 discs and instructions, sponsored by Gretna Ace Hardware (limit 1 per card)

items.name: Pickleball Kit
items.description: 2- or 4-player kit with paddles, 3 balls, and instructions, sponsored by SCHEELS (limit 1 per card)

items.name: Puzzles
items.description: Puzzles ranging from 25 to 2,500 pieces (limit 2 per card)

items.name: Story Time Kits
items.description: Pre-selected books, crafts, and games for at-home story time (limit 1 per card)

items.name: Telescope Kit
items.description: Telescope provided and maintained by Omaha Astronomical Society (limit 1 per card)

items.name: Ukulele Kit
items.description: Ukulele instrument with tuner (limit 1 per card)

metadata.source: Manual research from library websites and local news coverage
metadata.research_notes: Nebraska's Library of Things adoption is less widespread than New England. Major systems like Omaha Public Library and Lincoln City Libraries do not appear to have formal Library of Things programs. Gretna and Ralston are the confirmed programs found in the Omaha metro area.
